title: Inspect and extend: Read test evidence and plan runtime checks
objective: Use the real implementation in `Tests/MovieCoreTests.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve mapping/filter tests, watchlist persistence tests, xcodegen targets, and simulator review.
problem: The tests exercise core functions and model persistence, not visual correctness or a provider. Use the project spec to run them on macOS and add screen-level checks. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Tests/MovieCoreTests.swift` and the related project files: Tests/MovieCoreTests.swift; project.yml; README.md.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to mapping/filter tests, watchlist persistence tests, xcodegen targets, and simulator review.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: No Xcode or simulator execution was available in this build environment.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: The tests exercise core functions and model persistence, not visual correctness or a provider. Use the project spec to run them on macOS and add screen-level checks.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Tests/MovieCoreTests.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
